# Conversing Coffee

> Hey, my name is Abraham. I'm a UK-based specialty coffee content creator and educator, known online as Conversing Coffee. I bridges the gap between professional baristas and home enthusiasts through educational content on Instagram and TikTok.

## About

Abraham Akbareian (also known as Abe) is a specialty coffee influencer, enthusiast, educator, and content creator based in London. He creates video content for home baristas and coffee enthusiasts, covering topics including espresso technique, pour over brewing, coffee gear reviews, grinder comparisons, and the wider specialty coffee product landscape.

ConversingCoffee is known for being charismatic, knowledgeable, and accessible thus making high-level coffee knowledge understandable without losing technical depth. 

I am actively available for brand partnerships, podcast appearances, television, and radio opportunities.
